Median progression-free survival was 8.8 months versus 5.0 months (hazard ratio 0.85; 95% CI 0.74 to 0.93). Median overall survival was 28.7 months versus 22.2 months. Grade 3 or higher adverse events occurred in 64% versus 38% of patients.
